steps.content: The fridge is almost empty. There's just a pack of red beans, half a pack of rock sugar, and an egg. Outside the fridge, there are a few bottles of condiments and several packs of instant noodles. That's all the food in this house.

On your first day, she told you that you could use anything here. You remember when you cleaned out the fridge, you found quite a bit of meat and vegetables that had gone bad. All the edible food has already been consumed over the past few days.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Well, I really can't buy anything right now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Huh? But everything in your fridge has gone bad already, we really have to get some groceries.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I still haven't gotten paid for that order on you, so I'm out of cash for now.
She explains calmly, and shows you her account balance.

It's actually more than enough to buy some groceries from the local market. But according to Angell, in her line of work, enemies are everywhere. For safety reasons, hitmen don't go out unless necessary, and they order everything they need on <color=#fb9259>DisMyth</color>.
Shopping there is safe and secure, you can find everything you need, but the prices are simply outrageous.
Not convinced, you press on.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But aren't you a top-tier hitman who always takes on big jobs? You have no savings at all?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Saving money is useless; I could die at any time. I only take jobs when I'm almost out of money.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: They're all lined up waiting to hire me because I always get the job done quickly anyway. I can earn enough to last me half a year from one job.

If this were said by someone else, you might think they were fishing for sympathy and bragging about their wealth at the same time, but her expression tells you she's likely just thinking about sleep.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Don't worry, there's some instant noodles. Bought them on sale just in case. If you're hungry, just eat those.
Looking at the direction she's pointing, you walk to the dusty old cardboard box in the corner and reach inside.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry? These noodles have been expired for months.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Do instant noodles expire?
She asks the shocking question calmly.
Forget it, if the noodles aren't moldy, they should still be edible. Better than meat and vegetables that have started to smell and liquefy.
Perhaps a hundred years from now, your stomach will shock the DisCity's archaeologists.
You sigh, taking the red beans and rock sugar out of the fridge, and, after thinking for a moment, also take the instant noodles and the egg.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She's running errands all day and deserves a treat. Thank goodness she only wants <color=#fb9259>red bean soup</color>, not a full banquet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The money left in the account is probably just enough to buy some <color=#fb9259>discounted rice</color>, and a <color=#fb9259>cutting board</color>... Before the money comes in, we'll make do with porridge.
